tools.name: generate_routes
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a cycling, running or walking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a target distance or duration and optional climbing and scenery preferences, or a trip from a start to a destination, split into days (give destination, or dest_lng and dest_lat; distance

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a place by name or address and return matching places with their coordinates. Use it to confirm an ambiguous start before generating routes.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_routes" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
